name: Banshee Reeks Nature Preserve
method: Loudoun County lottery managed deer hunts, part of the state Deer Management Assistance Program; licensed, skilled hunters 18+; if drawn, buy a permit and attend an in-person orientation; antlerless only
dates: Hunts in October, December and February. Lottery registration Oct 1-31 for December hunts and Dec 1-31 for February hunts (Loudoun PRCS 2026 Fall Activity Guide). DWR's managed-hunts page also lists a novice deer-hunter workshop here (archery available at Banshee Reeks only), but its registration dates still read August 2023.
notes: Loudoun County park (DCR layer: Local Park, owner Loudoun County BOS, 739 ac in 5 tracts). The activity guide does not state the weapons. Contact BansheeReeks@loudoun.gov.
